text: Alé is a cycling-apparel brand of APG S.r.l. (near Verona, Italy); the UEC's partnership renewal announcement names Federico Zecchetto as the owner of APG S.r.l. and Alessia Piccolo as its CEO.
short: Alé is a brand of APG S.r.l., owned by Federico Zecchetto.

source.name: Union Européenne de Cyclisme: 'UEC and Alé together until 2029'
source.quote: the owner of APG S.r.l. Federico Zecchetto and the CEO of APG S.r.l. Alessia Piccolo, the company to which Alé belongs
